node.title: Re: Confused about Perl module installation
node.author: Anonymous Monk
node.doctext: When the Perl interpreter looks for packages, it refers first to the <tt>PERL5LIB</tt> environment variable, then to a built-in list that is hard coded into the executable when it is built. This is not the list that is consulted by the <tt>cpan</tt> command when it decides where to install a package. If the two do not correspond, then you will see the behavior that you are now seeing.
